summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine quarterly cash dividend declaration by its board. The resolution sets a total dividend of KRW 347,393,176,120 (KRW 740 per share) on 469,450,238 shares with a record date of July 30, 2026 and payment on August 28, 2026. No special situation event — an ordinary dividend announcement — no impact on ownership or control.
